purpose: Named safety rules enforced by claude/hooks/guard.py; an owner layer relaxes one with safety.allow: [id]

override_env.SOCRATEX_GUARD=0: disables the whole guard for one session (owner only, set outside the agent)
override_env.SOCRATEX_GUARD_ALLOW_SAFETY_EDIT=1: lets the agent edit the protected safety and config files for one session (owner only)

rules.what: Git commands that wipe uncommitted work of other sessions or rewrite shared history

enforce.reason: git reset --hard would destroy uncommitted work (other sessions share this tree).
git clean would delete untracked work.
Bulk checkout/restore of '.' would wipe uncommitted work.
Force push rewrites shared history; ask the owner.
Force-deleting a branch loses commits; ask the owner.

rules.what: git add -A, --all or . stages other sessions' uncommitted work; stage your own paths

enforce.reason: Stage your own paths only; add -A or . would sweep in other sessions' uncommitted work.

rules.what: Secret files (.env, keys, credentials) are never read or edited by the agent

enforce.reason: {name} looks like a secret file; the agent must not read or edit it.

rules.what: Whole-file dumps of the project's big ledger files (project .ai/guard.json big_files)
The reference packs folder (SOCRATEX_REFS, default ~/ai-refs) is read-only third-party content

enforce.reason: the reference packs folder is read-only third-party content; change nothing there.
enforce.bash_reason: the reference packs folder is read-only third-party content; use modules/tools/scripts/subrepos.py to manage it.

rules.what: Folders a project marks read-only in .ai/guard.json read_only_dirs
Commands a project blocks in .ai/guard.json blocked_commands
The agent must not edit the files that define or relax safety rules: only the owner edits them by hand

enforce.reason: {path} defines or relaxes safety rules; only the owner edits it by hand (owner override for one session: SOCRATEX_GUARD_ALLOW_SAFETY_EDIT=1).
